caption:
Remove the focus outline in your machine coding round and the accessibility follow-up comes next: "now use it with only the keyboard."

Look at the card. *:focus { outline: none } hides the focus ring everywhere. Mouse users don't notice. Keyboard users press Tab and can't tell which field or button they're on.

:focus-visible lets the browser decide when the ring is useful. It shows when you Tab, and usually not when you click a button with a mouse. Text fields still show it on click, because you need to see where you're typing.

WCAG 2.4.7 (Focus Visible) requires a visible focus indicator for keyboard users.

Source: MDN, :focus-visible.
